## Summary

- What changed and why?
- What is intentionally out of scope?

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant focused tests
- [ ] Full test suite
- [ ] Launch smoke check, when runtime behavior is affected
- [ ] `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` (plus staged/working-tree checks when applicable)

List the exact commands and results. Explain any unchecked item.

## Review State

- [ ] Ready for review

Keep the pull request in Draft state or label it clearly as WIP until this is checked. Formal change requests should not be submitted on draft/WIP work unless the author invites them.

## Source and Credit

Link any related issue, pull request, fork, or commit and explain whether this is an independent implementation, an adaptation, or directly incorporated work. Use `Co-authored-by` only for actual co-authorship.
